maria: Hey @sam @noah — starting a small sweep of the ‘First Run / Starter app’ quickstart. Found a couple of things that will confuse new users: the auth header example uses the non-standard `X-Api-Key` (we standardized on `Authorization: Bearer <token>`), the Python snippet omits the `stream=True` flag for streaming responses, and requirements.txt pins `redwood-inference==0.3` which blocks newer bugfixes. Planning a single docs PR to update docs/quickstart/first-run.md, docs/snippets/python/first_run.py, and the requirements example. Who can review?

sam: I can review this afternoon. Can you paste the minimal diffs/snippets here so I can skim before the PR? :+1:

maria: Sure — minimal changes below.

maria: ```python
# old (misleading) example
import requests
resp = requests.post(
  "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate",
  headers={"X-Api-Key": "<REDACTED>"},
  json={"prompt": "Hi"}
)
```

maria: Suggested replacement (show both REST and a small note about streaming):

maria: ```python
# recommended
import requests
resp = requests.post(
  "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate",
  headers={"Authorization": "Bearer <REDACTED_TOKEN>"},
  json={"prompt": "Hi", "max_tokens": 64},
  stream=True  # show streaming usage in quickstart
)
for chunk in resp.iter_lines():
  if chunk:
    print(chunk)
```

maria: And in requirements, change `redwood-inference==0.3` -> `redwood-inference>=0.3,<0.4` with a short note about pinning only for reproducible CI.

noah: Heads-up from SDK side: the Python client exposes a `.stream()` helper; the quickstart should show both the direct REST example (for people copying cURL) and the SDK shorthand. I'll add a one-line SDK example to docs/snippets/python/first_run.py in the PR if that's ok.

sam: Sounds good. We should also update the small callout near the top that mentions "we'll use X-Api-Key" — it's easy to miss. Also add a link to the auth best-practices doc.

olivia: Do we need to gate this on any SDK release? I don't want docs referencing API/headers that aren't live.

noah: No blocking release. Header normalization was deployed last week (logged in the changelog). The SDK change is backwards-compatible. Good to merge now and stage deploy to avoid broken links.

maria: I'll open the PR now: https://git.redwood.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4321 — will include the code snippets, requirements tweak, and a test in test-docs that ensures the quickstart code block contains `Authorization: Bearer`.

deploy-bot: docs-deploy: queued job for branch doc/first-run-fix (#4321)

sam: Assigned review. I'll look after lunch.

noah: I'll add the SDK snippet + small unit check for the snippet extraction in a followup commit to the same PR.

maria: Thanks all — tagging @sam and @noah on the PR. I'll request staging deploy once merged. :rocket:
